build_zipapp_archive: build a self-executing Python zipapp archive from manifest files using the zipapp build type
build_install_directory: build an install directory tree with a __main__ module from manifest-specified source files
install_library: install a Python library to a directory and generate an accompanying manifest file
parse_manifest: parse an FBPY manifest file and populate a path map with source to destination mappings
create_main_module: create a __main__.py entry point module that imports and calls a specified module and callable
